From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>

Subject: Re: Letters 
 
Fair. Didn’t think about that.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Sunday, February 17, 2019 11:00:40 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Letters 
 
Hey, man. Let’s snip this graf from letters.

I’m not comfortable exposing this much about our sourcing snafu. If you want to say, “I thought Michael Fulmer was going to ride with the Tigers to his hearing, but it didn’t end up happening” then that’s fine. But this is too much for me.

Last week, I sniffed out where the Tigers’ arbitration hearing with Michael Fulmer was, but nobody told me what time, so I didn’t go. I’m glad, because it would have been a big waste of time. Someone I trust told me that he was carpooling with team officials to St. Petersburg for the hearing and I didn’t understand why he’d make that up, so I tweeted it. A couple days later, someone else told me it didn’t happen. Another person said he asked, but Fulmer said he could drive instead. When I apologized for creating an urban legend, he said, “As long as you’re first.” It’s eating me up inside, so I think I’m going to try and make a vague mention of it in one of my stories.
